name: Kaya 0.1.2
changelog: Crake electric-teal dark theme, a stone-click sound, and a richer board (wood grain, shaded stones with drop shadows, and place/capture animations).

history.1: First build: offline board, full rules and scoring, SGF, and a computer opponent.
history.2: Dark theme (Crake palette) with a light/dark toggle, plus a tidier header.
history.3: Crake electric-teal palette, stone-click sound, and a richer board: wood grain, shaded stones with drop shadows, and place/capture animations.
